decision_rule: All phases must be passed, have at least one existing evidence file, have no missing evidence and no blockers, and the declared decision must match the derived decision before real_world_ready can be true.

phases.name: Diagnose and bound the claim
phases.target: Record what current engineering and evidence establish, separate research evidence from external and clinical validity, and prevent unsupported claims.
exit_criteria: Current metrics and protocol status are documented
Current limitations and claim boundary are explicit
phases.accountable_role: Project QA reviewer (local audit only; no clinical sign-off)

phases.name: Intended use and requirements
phases.target: Record the current research-only scope and, before clinical use, obtain accountable approval for one population, setting, user, prediction time, outcome, action, exclusions, comparator, and jurisdiction.
exit_criteria: Current research-only scope and prohibited clinical use documented
Signed clinical intended-use statement before any clinical-readiness claim
Requirements and harm analysis approved by clinical owner
blockers: Future clinical use is unspecified and has no clinical owner or approved decision threshold
Current experiments use different feature sets and endpoints
phases.accountable_role: Project lead and cardiology lead; named owners unassigned

phases.name: Data access, provenance, and rights
phases.target: Verify provenance, data-use authority, licenses, overlap, and redistribution restrictions for every development and evaluation dataset.
exit_criteria: All sources have documented permission and license/DUA
No unresolved patient-level overlap
No restricted data redistributed
blockers: Heart5 transformation/imputation provenance and Kaggle 70K licensing/redistribution remain unresolved; do not redistribute 70K until rights are confirmed
The 2021 Mendeley codebook lacks a diagnostic reference standard, so that benchmark is not pooled with the angiographic endpoint
The accessible Z-Alizadeh Sani cohort is endpoint-mismatched and has no patient identifiers for linkage
phases.accountable_role: Data steward and project lead; named owners unassigned

phases.name: Endpoint and feature alignment
phases.target: Freeze one clinically reviewed target definition and a complete feature map with units, timing, codebook, missingness, and inclusion rules.
exit_criteria: One unambiguous reference standard
Every deployed input is available before the prediction time
Zero patient overlap across partitions
blockers: Duke uses a stricter threshold
Z-Alizadeh Sani uses >=50% versus source >50%
AngioCAD replay was post-hoc
No single product feature map is selected
phases.accountable_role: Clinical informatician and cardiology lead; named owners unassigned

phases.name: Model, calibration, and policy lock
phases.target: Freeze one versioned model, feature map, calibration method, threshold, abstention rules, and protocol before the external test labels are available.
exit_criteria: Protocol and model hashes recorded before external evaluation
No target-label-driven model selection or threshold tuning
Inference failures abstain safely
blockers: There are separate study pipelines rather than one clinically specified product model
AngioCAD CD-XD-006 is post-hoc
phases.accountable_role: ML lead and statistician; named owners unassigned

phases.name: Internal validation
phases.target: Run patient/group-aware nested evaluation with prespecified repeats, baseline comparisons, uncertainty intervals, calibration, and subgroup accounting.
exit_criteria: At least five prespecified random seeds where random splitting applies
Primary metrics and intervals match the frozen analysis plan
All intended groups and failure cases reported
blockers: The repeated runs use row-level random splits because complete patient/group identifiers are unavailable
Patient-level uncertainty intervals and intended-subgroup accounting are incomplete
The five-seed analysis is exploratory because seed-42 results were already examined
phases.accountable_role: Statistician and ML lead; named owners unassigned

phases.name: Untouched external evaluation
phases.target: Evaluate a frozen model once on at least two independent health systems/cohorts, with one untouched primary test, compatible labels, and power/precision-based sample size.
exit_criteria: No development/test patient overlap
Endpoint and feature compatibility approved
95% CI half-width <=0.05 for ROC-AUC and <=0.20 for calibration slope, unless stricter limits are preregistered
Use-specific primary safety metric meets its clinician-approved lower-bound target
External cohort results reproduce from saved predictions
blockers: No untouched endpoint-compatible public cohort was secured; Z-Alizadeh Sani uses >=50% versus source >50%
AngioCAD was previously examined, and person-level overlap cannot be ruled out for the public cohorts
The 2026 Mendeley 918-row public release exactly duplicates Heart5 and is not an independent target cohort
phases.accountable_role: Independent site PI and statistician; named owners unassigned

phases.name: Calibration, uncertainty, and operating envelope
phases.target: Meet clinically agreed calibration, selective-risk, automatic-coverage, and shift-detection limits at every intended site and subgroup.
exit_criteria: C_min and R_max set before external results
Confidence bounds meet agreed limits
Unknown sites and invalid inputs never emit actionable scores
Shift detector validated on held-out sites
blockers: AngioCAD automatic coverage is 5.6%
Feature-only OOD separation is weak
No clinician-approved operating thresholds
phases.accountable_role: Cardiology lead and statistician; named owners unassigned

phases.name: Subgroup safety, usability, and human factors
phases.target: Demonstrate adequate subgroup precision, clear failure communication, and usability in the intended clinical workflow.
exit_criteria: Subgroups prespecified with adequate sample size
Clinician and representative-user usability review completed
Unsupported groups clearly restricted
blockers: No intended user or site
No powered subgroup or usability study
phases.accountable_role: Human-factors lead and patient/public representative; named owners unassigned

phases.name: Prospective clinical evaluation
phases.target: Complete an approved prospective silent-mode evaluation at intended sites before the model influences care.
exit_criteria: Ethics and institutional approvals
Registered protocol and adjudicated outcomes
Prospective performance and workflow harms meet prespecified limits
blockers: No clinical partner, approved protocol, or prospective dataset
phases.accountable_role: Site PI and ethics committee; named owners unassigned

phases.name: Software safety, privacy, security, and quality system
phases.target: Establish risk-based software lifecycle controls, privacy/security review, traceable requirements, release/change control, incident handling, and rollback.
exit_criteria: No unacceptable open hazards
No unresolved critical security findings
Critical safety requirements trace to tests
Release and rollback independently verified
blockers: Current QA covers research software integrity only
No product security or quality-system evidence
phases.accountable_role: Software quality, privacy, and security leads; named owners unassigned

phases.name: Regulatory determination and authorization
phases.target: Obtain a qualified jurisdiction-specific device determination and all required investigation, manufacturing, and marketing permissions.
exit_criteria: Manufacturer and intended jurisdiction identified
Required regulatory authorization obtained before clinical use
Claims and labeling reviewed
blockers: Jurisdiction, manufacturer, and intended-use function are not selected
No regulatory review or authorization
phases.accountable_role: Manufacturer and regulatory affairs specialist; named owners unassigned

phases.name: Controlled release and post-market monitoring
phases.target: Operate staged release with site-specific drift/performance monitoring, escalation, incident review, rollback, and periodic re-evaluation.
exit_criteria: Monitoring thresholds and owners defined
Rollback and incident drills pass
No release until G1-G11 pass
blockers: No authorized product or deployment site
phases.accountable_role: Product operations and post-market safety lead; named owners unassigned
